files.mismatch_score.pkl: Mismatch penalty matrix (240 entries). Key format: r<RNA_wt>:d<DNA_RC_off>,<position>.
files.pam_scores.pkl: PAM score matrix (16 dinucleotide entries). GG=1.0 for SpCas9 NGG.
files.cfd-score-calculator.py: Upstream Python 2 calculator (reference only, not used by VEYRA).

algorithm.description: CFD = product of position-specific mismatch penalties * PAM score
algorithm.score_range: [0, 1]. Higher = more likely to be cut (more concerning off-target).
